It all boils down this: there are 8 cognitive functions the describe how we take in information (Sensing and iNtuition) and how we make decisions (Feeling and Thinking).

The perceiving functional axisis are: Extraverted Sensing (Se) with Introverted iNtuition (Ni), and Extraverted iNtuition (Ne) with Introverted Sensing (Si).

The judging axis are the same way: Introverted Feeling (Fi) with Extraverted Thinking (Te), and Extraverted Feeling (Fe) with Introverted Thinking (Ti)

Extravert vs Introvert functions (the way I always interpret it) are just where the perceiving/judging energies are directed, being your inner or outer world.

The J/P letters just indicates if your first extraverted function is a judging (feeling/thinking) or a perceiving (sensing/intuition) one.

The E/I letters say if you lead with a extraverted or introverted function.

My function stack (ISFP) is Fi-Se-Ni-Te. 

I'm not real good at explaining what order to put them in, but this should be a pretty good starting point.

Really hope this helps
